title: P8a training-size pilot
decision: decisions.md §19 P7d (17 Nov 2026, Devansh): training draws every size n = 8..20, 3,000 solvable networks in equal quotas per size; validation 400 solvable, same size mix; the training and validation generation caps per size come from a pilot on the merged generator (null until then). Method of §18 P6c item 5 / P6d item 4 (accepted): rates within +-2 percentage points, cap = smallest N with P(Binomial(N, Wilson low) >= quota) >= 1 - eps.
registry: the training cell mirrors configs/d28_cohorts.json d28_train and d28_val (tree, core, Linux 0.5, p 1, held-out product exim and the CVE holdout v2 excluded, n = 8..20); a test checks it against the registry
tasks_rule: worst case p = 0.5: 1.96 * sqrt(0.25 / 2401) = 0.0200, so every size's 95% interval half-width is at most 2 percentage points whatever its rate

training.rule: cap per size = smallest N with P(Binomial(N, r_low) >= 231) >= 0.999, r_low the size's Wilson 95% lower bound; 231 per size x 13 sizes = 3,003 (OQ-P7d-1)

validation.rule: same rule with quota 31 per size x 13 sizes = 403 (OQ-P7d-1); validation draws the training cell under its own seeds (d28.val)

test_rule: no test cohort in this pilot (test sizes: P6d pilot run 2026-11-17T082305Z-b79a752)
